title: Re: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Rattle Tooth's Revengeance
description: Re: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Rattle Tooth's Revengeance — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul again in Rattle Tooth's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section, slay 8 Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blademasters again and 6 Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blasters again, then return to the Townston Commander...again.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul again in Rattle Tooth's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section, slay 8 Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blademasters again and 6 Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blasters again, then return to the Townston Commander...again.

Offer:

This is what I like to call research by repetition. Don't worry, there is nothing scientific about it, just some old fashion elbow grease. I am hoping that by mindlessly churning through this task you may, by sheer osmosis alone, learn more about this situation. It is important that you do not think hard during the process or you are liable to get a brain cramp or pull a medulla oblongata muscle.

Make you way into Rattle Tooth's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section which is off of Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Once there begin slaying and do not stop until Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul, 8 of Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blademasters, and 6 of Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blasters are properly slainified. Return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston when you have met your slay quota.

Turn-in:

Well done. No new news, so feel free to try this quest again to kill some time.

Objectives:

  • Slay Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul
  • Slay Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blademasters
  • Slay Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blasters

Client level range: 77–100
